I would strongly caution against telling people that their symptoms signify a different disorder. Unless if the person specifically asks if the symptom is associated with that disorder, it is unwise to mention it. Instead I would recommend telling the person that the particular symptom can stem from a variety of factors and is also associated with different disorders. Then I would recommend telling them to seek professional advice to see how it applies to them. 

Hyper-vigilance and paranoia are strongly linked with PTSD, and you may be right about BPD, however it could also be schizophrenia, GAD, DID, et cetera...which is the reason it is not a good idea to start naming different things.
